title: Cancún Airport to Cancún Hotel Zone
content:
Cancún Airport to Cancún Hotel Zone transportation

Pre-booked private transportation takes you from Cancún International Airport (CUN) to your hotel in the Cancún Hotel Zone (Zona Hotelera), 15 to 30 km away along Kukulcán Boulevard. After immigration, baggage claim and customs, your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation. We track your flight, so a delay does not cost you the pickup.

The vehicle is for your party only: no other passengers, no stops at other resorts, and one fixed price per vehicle, not per person.

Cancún Airport to Cancún Hotel Zone transfers

Each Cancún Airport to Hotel Zone transfer goes door to door, from the resorts near Punta Nizuc at the south end, closest to the airport, to the hotels around Playa Caracol, Punta Cancún and the party center at kilometer 9. Most transfers take 20 to 30 minutes; the hotels at the northern end of the strip take the longest.

Give your hotel name when you book: the Hotel Zone is one long road, and your hotel sets the drop-off point.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Cancún Hotel Zone

Our Cancún Airport to Hotel Zone shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus. It leaves as soon as you are through arrivals, instead of waiting for other travelers or stopping at a dozen resorts on the way, and has room for suitcases, strollers and golf bags. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Cancún Hotel Zone

The Hotel Zone is a 7-shaped island joined to the mainland at both ends, with the open Caribbean on one side and the calm Nichupté Lagoon on the other. Almost every big resort in Cancún sits along its single road, Kukulcán Boulevard, numbered by kilometer.

Areas of the Hotel Zone

Punta Cancún and Playa Caracol (km 8–10). The corner of the 7, with the convention center, nightclubs, restaurants and the busiest beaches. Lively day and night.

Playa Gaviota Azul and Playa Chac Mool (km 9–11). Wide beaches just south of the corner, within walking distance of the bars and shops.

Playa Marlín, Playa Ballenas and Playa Delfines (km 13–18). The long eastern stretch of large all-inclusive resorts, with open surf and the "Cancún" sign at Playa Delfines.

Punta Nizuc (km 19–21). The southern tip, quieter and the closest part of the Hotel Zone to the airport.

Beaches and things to do

The beaches on the north side, facing Isla Mujeres, have calm water for swimming; the eastern beaches have stronger waves. Across the boulevard, the lagoon is the place for jet skis, kayaks and sunset cruises. The Mayan ruins of El Rey and the Maya Museum sit near kilometer 16, and La Isla and Kukulcán Plaza are the main shopping malls.

About the transfer to Cancún Hotel Zone

The drive follows the highway north from the airport and turns onto Kukulcán Boulevard at Punta Nizuc. Allow 20 to 30 minutes, a little more at rush hour.

title: Cancún Airport to Cancún Downtown
content:
Cancún Airport to Cancún Downtown transportation

Pre-booked private transportation takes you from Cancún International Airport (CUN) to your hotel, apartment or address in downtown Cancún, about 20 km north along Avenida Tulum or Bonampak. Your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation, and we track your flight so a delay does not cost you the pickup.

The vehicle is for your party only, with one fixed price per vehicle, not per person.

Cancún Airport to Cancún Downtown transfers

Each Cancún Airport to Downtown transfer goes door to door: to Avenida Tulum and the bus station, the Mercado 28 and Parque de las Palapas area, Avenida Bonampak and Puerto Cancún, or the residential neighborhoods (supermanzanas). Most rides take 20 to 30 minutes.

Give the exact address when you book. Downtown streets are numbered by block (SM), and the address sets your drop-off.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Cancún Downtown

Our Cancún Airport to Downtown shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus: it leaves as soon as you are through arrivals and goes straight to your address. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Cancún Downtown

Downtown Cancún (El Centro) is where most of the city's people live and work, a short drive inland from the beaches of the Hotel Zone. Hotels here cost less, and the food is local.

What to see

Parque de las Palapas. The main square, with street food stalls and live music in the evening.

Mercado 28. The market for crafts, souvenirs and simple Yucatecan restaurants.

Puerto Cancún and Malecón Tajamar. The newer waterfront district, with a marina, a mall and a walkway along the mangroves.

Puerto Juárez. The ferry terminals for Isla Mujeres, ten minutes north of the center.

About the transfer to Cancún Downtown

The drive goes north from the airport along Highway 307 and into the city. Allow 20 to 30 minutes, longer at rush hour.

title: Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres
content:
Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres transportation

Pre-booked private transportation takes you from Cancún International Airport (CUN) to your resort in Playa Mujeres, about 35 km north of the airport, past downtown Cancún. Your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation, and we track your flight, so a delay does not cost you the pickup.

The vehicle is for your party only: no other passengers, no stops at other resorts, one fixed price per vehicle.

Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres transfers

Each Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres transfer goes door to door, to the resorts along the Playa Mujeres beach and golf course, opposite Isla Mujeres. Allow 35 to 45 minutes, depending on traffic through the city.

Give your resort name when you book: it sets the drop-off point and the final price.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres

Our Cancún Airport to Playa Mujeres shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus. It leaves when you are through arrivals, stops only at your resort and has room for all your luggage. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Playa Mujeres

Playa Mujeres is a gated resort area on the mainland north of Cancún, facing Isla Mujeres across a calm channel. It has a golf course designed by Greg Norman and a row of large all-inclusive resorts, with almost no traffic or nightlife.

What to know

The beaches are wide and the water is calm, because Isla Mujeres shelters the coast. Restaurants and shops are mostly inside the resorts; downtown Cancún is 20 to 30 minutes away by car, and the Isla Mujeres ferries leave from Puerto Juárez, on the way.

About the transfer to Playa Mujeres

The drive crosses Cancún to the north and follows the coast road past Puerto Juárez. Allow 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca
content:
Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca transportation

Pre-booked private transportation takes you from Cancún International Airport (CUN) to Isla Blanca, the peninsula at the northern end of the Costa Mujeres road. Your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation, and we track your flight.

The vehicle is for your party only, with one fixed price per vehicle.

Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca transfers

Each Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca transfer goes to your hotel, villa or beach club on the peninsula. Allow 50 to 60 minutes; the last part of the road is narrow and partly unpaved.

Give the exact address or the name of your villa when you book.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca

Our Cancún Airport to Isla Blanca shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus, with room for luggage and kitesurfing gear. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Isla Blanca

Isla Blanca is not an island but a long, thin peninsula north of Costa Mujeres, with the open sea on one side and the shallow Chacmuchuch Lagoon on the other. It has a few small hotels and villas and very few people.

What to do

The lagoon is one of the best kitesurfing spots near Cancún, with flat water and steady wind. The sea side has wide, empty beaches. Bring what you need: there are only a couple of beach restaurants.

About the transfer to Isla Blanca

The drive goes north through Cancún, along the Costa Mujeres road and onto the peninsula. Allow 50 to 60 minutes.

title: Cancún Airport to Isla Mujeres
content:
Cancún Airport to Isla Mujeres transportation

Isla Mujeres has no bridge, so your private transportation from Cancún International Airport (CUN) takes you to the ferry for the island, on the Cancún side. Your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation, and we track your flight so a delay does not cost you the pickup.

The vehicle is for your party only, with one fixed price per vehicle.

Cancún Airport to Isla Mujeres transfers

The ferries to Isla Mujeres leave from Puerto Juárez and Gran Puerto, north of downtown Cancún, about 25 to 35 minutes from the airport. The crossing takes about 20 minutes, with departures through the day and evening. Ferry tickets are not included in the transfer price.

On the island, most visitors get around by golf cart, taxi or on foot.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Isla Mujeres

Our Cancún Airport to Isla Mujeres ferry shuttle is a private van for your party, straight to the terminal, with no stops at hotels on the way. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Isla Mujeres

Isla Mujeres is a 7 km long island facing Cancún, with a relaxed town at its northern tip and calm, shallow water at Playa Norte, often listed among the best beaches in Mexico.

What to do

Playa Norte. Soft sand and clear, shallow water, steps from the town.

Punta Sur. The cliffs at the southern tip, the easternmost point of Mexico, with a sculpture garden and the remains of a Maya temple.

Snorkeling and whale sharks. Boats leave for the reefs and, from June to September, for whale shark tours.

About the transfer to Isla Mujeres

The drive goes north through Cancún to the ferry terminal. Allow 25 to 35 minutes, then about 20 minutes on the ferry.

content:

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Puerto Morelos

Our Cancún Airport to Puerto Morelos shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus. It leaves when you are through arrivals and goes straight to your hotel. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Puerto Morelos

Puerto Morelos is the closest town to the airport on the Riviera Maya, a small fishing village that kept its quiet pace while the coast around it filled with resorts.

Areas of Puerto Morelos

The village. A small square, a leaning lighthouse, seafood restaurants and a beach a few steps away.

The resort coast. Large all-inclusive resorts north and south of the village, on long, calm beaches.

Colonia (inland). The local town on the other side of the highway, with markets and everyday shops.

Reef and nature

The Puerto Morelos Reef National Park lies a few hundred meters offshore, and boats leave from the village pier for snorkeling. Inland, the Ruta de los Cenotes road leads to several swimming cenotes, and the Botanical Garden sits just south of town.

About the transfer to Puerto Morelos

The drive goes south along Highway 307. Allow 25 to 35 minutes.

This stretch of the Riviera Maya is a line of large resorts on private beaches, each reached by its own road from the highway through the jungle. There is no town: restaurants and activities are at the resorts, and Playa del Carmen is 15 to 20 minutes south.

Beaches

Maroma and Playa del Secreto have some of the widest, whitest beaches on the coast. The Puerto Morelos reef continues offshore, so the sea is usually calm.

content:
Cancún Airport to Playa del Carmen transportation

Pre-booked private transportation takes you from Cancún International Airport (CUN) to your hotel, condo or rental in Playa del Carmen, about 55 km south along Highway 307. Give the exact address when you book. Playa del Carmen's areas are priced differently, and the address sets your final price.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Playa del Carmen

Our Cancún Airport to Playa del Carmen shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus. It leaves as soon as you are through arrivals and makes no stops at other resorts along the highway. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Playa del Carmen

Playa del Carmen grew from a fishing village into the biggest town of the Riviera Maya, halfway between Cancún and Tulum. Most of its life happens on foot, along Quinta Avenida, a pedestrian street one block from the beach.

Areas of Playa del Carmen

Downtown and Quinta Avenida. Shops, restaurants and bars along the pedestrian Fifth Avenue, with the beach a block away.

Playacar. A gated area south of the ferry pier, with all-inclusive resorts, a golf course and quiet residential streets.

Coco Beach and the north. Newer hotels and condos with calmer beaches.

The ferry pier. Ferries to Cozumel leave from the end of Calle 1 Sur, next to the main square.

Nearby

The Xcaret and Xplor parks are 10 minutes south, cenotes line the road inland, and Tulum is about an hour further down the coast.

About the transfer to Playa del Carmen

The drive runs south along Highway 307 through the Riviera Maya. Allow 45 minutes to an hour.

title: Cancún Airport to Cozumel
content:
Cancún Airport to Cozumel transportation

To reach Cozumel from Cancún International Airport (CUN), your private transportation takes you to the passenger ferry in Playa del Carmen. Your driver meets you outside the terminal named in your confirmation, and we track your flight so a delay does not cost you the pickup.

The vehicle is for your party only, with one fixed price per vehicle.

Cancún Airport to Cozumel transfers

The drive to the Playa del Carmen ferry pier takes 50 minutes to an hour. Ferries to Cozumel leave through the day and the crossing takes about 40 minutes. Ferry tickets are not included in the transfer price.

Check the last ferry of the day before you choose your flight: a late landing may mean a night in Playa del Carmen.

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Cozumel

Our Cancún Airport to Cozumel ferry shuttle is a private van for your party, straight to the pier, with no stops at resorts on the way. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Cozumel

Cozumel is a 48 km long island off Playa del Carmen, with one town, San Miguel, on its western shore. It is one of the best diving destinations in the world.

What to do

The reefs of the Cozumel Reefs National Park run along the southwest coast, with clear water and strong drift dives. The wild eastern coast has empty beaches, and the Maya site of San Gervasio sits in the middle of the island.

About the transfer to Cozumel

The drive goes south along Highway 307 to the ferry pier in Playa del Carmen. Allow 50 minutes to an hour, then about 40 minutes on the ferry.

Snorkeling in Akumal Bay is managed to protect the turtles, so check the current rules when you arrive. Yal-Kú lagoon, at Half Moon Bay, is a calm inlet for snorkeling, and the Dos Ojos and Casa Cenote cenotes are 15 minutes south.

title: Cancún Airport to Cobá
content:
Cancún Airport to Cobá transportation

Shuttle from Cancún Airport to Cobá

Our Cancún Airport to Cobá shuttle is a private van for your party, not a shared bus, with no stops on the way. A minibus takes groups of up to 12 passengers.

About Cobá

Cobá was a large Maya city, linked to others by raised white roads (sacbeob), and its ruins are spread through the jungle around two lagoons. Its main pyramid, Nohoch Mul, is one of the tallest in the Yucatán.

What to do

The site is big, so most visitors rent a bicycle or a pedicab to move between the groups of buildings. Several cenotes, such as Choo-Ha, Tamcach-Ha and Multun-Ha, are a few minutes away.

About the transfer to Cobá

The drive goes south to Tulum and then inland, or across by the Nuevo Xcán road. Allow about two hours.

About Chichén Itzá

Chichén Itzá was one of the largest Maya cities and is today the most visited archaeological site in Mexico. Its pyramid, El Castillo, was built so that at the equinoxes the shadow of a serpent seems to slide down its steps.
